description: A fixed-rate loan's monthly payment is the level amount that pays off the balance with interest over the number of months, and this tool computes it for a mortgage, land contract or other installment note. Optionally leaves a balloon. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.
